provenance: Synthetic CAL-01 development fixtures. The first 14 cases copy critic_development_cases.json (left unchanged so its recorded hashes stay valid) and add per-fact annotations; the two signer cases are new. Requested-fact lists, answered flags and match_terms are AI-proposed, not human judgments, and none of these are calibration or final-split questions. Four complete cases (side_detail_not_requested, derived_answer, applies_rate_stated, unrequested_confirmation) model the historical over-asking refusals recorded on hira/dev (qst_0454, qst_0314, qst_0420, qst_0462 patterns); they are paraphrased synthetic text, not those questions.

cases.question: What caused Acme EU vectorization requests to route to Asia during the March 15 incident?
cases.evidence: March 15 Acme EU vectorization incident RCA: control-plane heartbeat lag made residency stamps stale, so fallback selected the nearest healthy edge, including Asia.
